# 10. SSD/AFK Rules
SSD (Space Sleep Disorder) is a term used to indicate players who have disconnected from the game, but could still return to their character if they reconnect. It is indicated by a pair of floating Z’s next to their character.
- Do not steal from, attack, or take any major actions towards a recently disconnected player, indicated by the Zz icon being green. - You may steal from or attack a player who has been SSD for a moderate period of time, indicated by the Zz icon being yellow or red, if doing so is required for your antag objectives. - A player whose Zz icon has turned red is considered to have left the game. Their bodies may be dragged into cryosleep pods.
## Allowed - Dragging an SSD character in the middle of a hallway into a nearby chair. - Treating the wounds of an SSD character. - Stealing the requisition digiboard from an SSD Quartermaster whose icon has turned yellow or red, and you have a thief objective to do so. - Attacking an SSD player accidentally or in a situation in which it would be unreasonable not to, such as a Nuclear Operative killing every single person in a room.
## Not Allowed - Dragging an SSD character into maints so you don’t have to look at them. - Taking an SSD character’s ID, copying its access with your Agent ID, and then putting it back. - Dragging an Assistant who fell asleep at the bar and went SSD onto the salvage shuttle and taking them on an expedition.
